prompt: Create a highly detailed realistic anime-style portrait of a young woman in her early twenties sitting in profile at a vintage wooden dressing table at night, quietly brushing or gathering her long dark brown hair with both hands. She has a delicate face, pale skin, soft natural lips, straight bangs, very long flowing hair, and wears thin round wire-frame glasses. Her expression is calm, introspective, and slightly melancholic as she looks downward toward her hair. She is dressed in a loose white Victorian-style nightgown with lace trim at the neckline and cuffs. The room is an old wooden bedroom with a chair, a curtained window on the left showing a deep blue moonlit night, framed landscape paintings on the wall, and an oval mirror on the right. A single lit candle or oil lamp on the dressing table casts warm golden light on her hands, face, hair, and the mirror, contrasting with cool blue moonlight from the window. Composition is vertical 2:3, medium shot from the side, seated figure occupying most of the frame, intimate quiet atmosphere, cinematic lighting, soft shadows, painterly realism, ultra-detailed hair strands, fabric folds, wood grain, and glass reflections. Use a muted palette of midnight blue, warm amber, cream white, and dark wood brown. No text, no watermark, no extra characters, avoid modern objects.

promptZh: 创作一幅高度精细的写实动漫风格肖像，画面中一位 二十出头的年轻女性 在夜晚侧身坐在复古木质梳妆台前，双手正安静地梳理或拢起她那 深棕色 的长发。她面容精致，皮肤白皙，嘴唇自然柔和，留着直刘海，长发如瀑，戴着细圆框眼镜。她神情平静、内敛，带着一丝忧郁，目光低垂看向自己的头发。她身着一件宽松的 带有蕾丝领口和袖口的白色维多利亚风格睡裙。房间是一间古老的木质卧室，配有一把椅子，左侧有带窗帘的窗户，透出深蓝色的月夜，墙上挂着装裱好的风景画，右侧有一面椭圆形的镜子。梳妆台上的一支点燃的蜡烛或油灯，将温暖的金色光芒投射在她的双手、脸庞、头发和镜子上，与窗外清冷的蓝色月光形成对比。构图采用 2:3 纵向比例，侧面中景，人物坐姿占据画面主体，营造出私密宁静的氛围，电影级光影，柔和阴影，绘画般的写实感，超精细的发丝、布料褶皱、木纹和玻璃反射。色调采用柔和的午夜蓝、暖琥珀色、奶油白和深木棕。无文字，无水印，无多余字符，避免出现现代物品。
